name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.06: Rokumai no Hankou
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.06 6枚の犯行
source:
A famous photographer asks her daughter to be guarded. The day after Jinguji Temple was laid, a murder occurred in the apartment where Sayaka Kuju was located.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位著名摄影师委托神宫寺保护自己的女儿。神宫寺在九条沙耶香所在的公寓安顿下来的次日，那里便发生了一起谋杀案。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
